subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 9th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul.
source_quote: ## 9th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul

subject: Greengrass festival
fact: The festival of Greengrass was a tradition of the farming communities near the giants.
source_quote: The festival of Greengrass was a tradition of the farming communities near the giants he lived with.

subject: Duergar invisibility
fact: The Duergar can become invisible for a whole hour.
source_quote: Hemeth laughs, "Yes, that would be a good thing to worry about. The Duergar can become invisible for a whole hour." And he turns invisible.

subject: Gracklstugh ambiance
fact: Gracklstugh appears as one large work camp, with the sound of hammers, stench and heat, and the light of smelters.
source_quote: The buildings are plain and functional... the sound of hammers warping metals, the stench and heat, and the light of the smelters make all of Gracklstugh appear as one large work camp.

subject: jug of liquid generation
fact: The jug found in the keelboat can generate any liquid, and the first liquid generated was mayonnaise.
source_quote: He finds some gold and a jug that he learns later can be used to generate any liquid. The first liquid they generate is mayonnaise.

subject: Blade Bazaar
fact: The Blade Bazaar is a marketplace where the duergar sell almost everything, with din of arguing nearly drowning forge hammering.
source_quote: This marketplace is named after the most abundant goods the duergar offer, but the shops here sell almost everything available in the city... The din of people arguing, mainly in Dwarvish, nearly drowns out the hammering coming from the city’s forges.

subject: Darklake District
fact: Non-Duergars are only permitted to move freely in the Darklake District.
source_quote: Non-Duergars are only permitted to move freely in the Darklake district.

subject: Eldritch Claw Tattoo
fact: An Eldritch Claw Tattoo can be purchased in Gracklstugh but not in the Darklake District.
source_quote: Zalthir has been thinking about some magical items he wants and was disappointed when Hemeth said that magical goods could be purchased in Gracklstugh but not in the Darklake District.

subject: Duergar slave trade
fact: The Duergar capture slaves that they sell in Gracklstugh.
source_quote: Yes, they capture slaves that they sell in Gracklstugh.

subject: Duergar merchant deception
fact: Many Duergar merchants give different prices, deny statements, or talk to invisible brothers during transactions.
source_quote: Many duergar merchants give different prices to buy or sell the same items whenever they are asked... a merchant suddenly turns invisible during a transaction... a merchant denies ever saying so... starts talking to someone he refers to as his brother.

subject: Gates of Darklake District
fact: The gates at the end of the road isolate the Darklake District from the rest of Gracklstugh.
source_quote: The gates at the end of the road keep the Darklake District isolated from the rest of the city.

subject: Two-headed giant
fact: A two-headed, gray-skinned giant burst through a gate, howling madly and killing a duergar soldier.
source_quote: A two-headed, gray-skinned giant burst through a gate, howling madly and lashing out left and right... one of his swings connects with a duergar soldier, whose broken body flies through the air and crashes near you with a sickening crunch.

subject: Tongue of Madness
fact: The Tongue of Madness is a mushroom that, when eaten, forces the consumer to reveal true thoughts.
source_quote: Zalthir hands him a mushroom, The Tongue of Madness, and says, "Eat." And Buppido does and starts talking.

subject: Duergar invisibility capability
fact: The Duergar can become invisible at will; you never know who is watching.
source_quote: The Duergar can become invisible at will; you never know who is watching.

subject: Underdark journey
fact: The long journey through the dark waters of the Underdark has led them to Gracklstugh.
source_quote: The long journey through the dark waters of the Underdark has led him here to the metropolis of the Duergar in this part of the Underdark.

subject: Religious conflict vs. political rivalry
fact: Grygum concludes that the conflict between Dwarves and Duergar is rooted in resource competition, not religious dogma.
source_quote: The Dwarves and the Duergar compete for the same resources, and political conflict may matter more than any religious principle or dogma.

subject: Interplanar gate travel
fact: Bringing avatars of outer plane powers requires powerful magic and artifacts, no longer possible since the Second Sundering.
source_quote: The great powers of the outer planes in the Time of Trouble could enter the Prime Material Plane at will... Aos, the overgod, has ended that era with the Second Sundering.

subject: Gracklstugh walls
fact: The walls of Duergar homes are plain, unlike the etchings and art of Drow homes.
source_quote: Whereas the Drow would have decorated their homes with etchings and art, the walls of the Duergar homes are plain.

subject: Dulgir's mace
fact: Grygum purchases a mace from merchant Dulgir after the merchant shifts to speaking with a Baldurian patriar tone.
source_quote: Grygum... asks if he wants to buy or sell. "Sell this mace?"... the Duergar suddenly shifts, speaking with the stilted tongue of a Baldurian patriar... He is the proud owner of a new mace.
